data.description: Gems Estates 1 – A Vision of Prestige and Elegance

data.answer:
Gems Estates 1 at DAMAC Hills is set to become an exclusive haven of luxury, seamlessly blending modern architectural brilliance with lush green surroundings. Designed by DAMAC Properties, this forthcoming sub-community envisions a serene residential experience, where elegant villas will be enveloped by forestry-inspired landscapes. Future homeowners will enjoy panoramic views of the Trump International Golf Club, an exceptional championship course designed by the renowned Gil Hanse.

Positioned within the vibrant master development of DAMAC Hills, Gems Estates 1 will be part of an elite collection of over 30 sub-communities centered around this world-class golf destination. Once completed, this gated enclave will offer residents access to state-of-the-art facilities, including high-end retail spaces, recreational parks, and a wealth of wellness and leisure amenities.

The features of Gems Estates villas by DAMAC will set new benchmarks for elegance, boasting sophisticated interiors and meticulously designed exteriors that reflect a perfect fusion of luxury and nature. As an off-plan development, it presents an exciting opportunity for investors and homeowners to secure a residence in one of Dubai’s most sought-after communities.

The development will offer five meticulously designed villa layouts, each showcasing unparalleled architectural brilliance. According to the master plan, the V28-G and V31-G models will feature expansive five-bedroom residences, while the V55-G and V1000-G configurations will redefine luxury with six-bedroom, mansion-style villas. The most exclusive of all, the V75-G layout, will stand as the only seven-bedroom villa option within Gems Estates 1, DAMAC Hills.

These upcoming residences will epitomize elegance, seamlessly blending modern sophistication with nature-inspired surroundings. Each home will be thoughtfully crafted to provide open-plan living spaces, private outdoor areas, and breathtaking views of DAMAC Hills' lush landscapes.

This visionary project will boast bold exteriors with refined curves and gold-accented interiors, creating a striking contrast that exudes elegance. A seamless blend of serene water elements and lush greenery will enhance the community’s natural appeal, evoking a forest-like ambiance unique to Gems Estates 1.

The upcoming collection of 5, 6, and 7-bedroom villas will be a testament to grandeur, featuring double-height ceilings that amplify space and light. Future residents can look forward to an impressive lineup of amenities, including multiple covered parking spaces, a Jacuzzi, an elevated swimming pool, an outdoor lounge, an indoor gym, a game room, and a private cinema. Every detail is designed to provide a lifestyle of comfort and exclusivity.

Beyond aesthetics, functionality takes center stage in these meticulously designed homes. The features of Gems Estates villas by DAMAC will include a maid’s room, driver’s quarter, laundry area, casual and formal living spaces, a family lounge, and a home office. The thoughtfully planned kitchen spaces—closed, show, and service kitchens—offer practicality without compromising elegance. With ensuite bedrooms, walk-in closets, and expansive terraces, these villas will redefine modern luxury in Gems Estates 1, DAMAC Hills.

Renting a Property in Gems Estates 1

As Gems Estates 1, DAMAC Hills is still under development, rental opportunities are not yet available. However, once completed, this exclusive villa community is expected to offer some of the most sought-after luxury rentals in Dubai. With its branded interiors, world-class amenities, and serene golf course surroundings, it will cater to elite tenants seeking an extraordinary living experience. Future rental listings are likely to feature expansive multi-bedroom mansions with private pools, home theaters, and dedicated entertainment spaces, making Gems Estates 1 a highly desirable address for those who value sophistication and privacy.

Buying a Property in DAMAC Hills Gems Estates 1

For investors and homebuyers, DAMAC Hills Gems Estates 1 presents a unique opportunity to secure a branded luxury residence in one of Dubai’s most prestigious communities. The developer has introduced a flexible 80/20 payment plan, allowing buyers to reserve their property with a 20% booking fee, followed by 60% spread across the construction phase, and the remaining 20% upon handover. 

This structured plan ensures ease of investment while securing an opulent home featuring expansive layouts, designer interiors, and unparalleled golf course views. Given its exclusivity and limited availability, early investment in Gems Estates 1 is expected to yield significant returns, making it a prime choice for discerning buyers.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Gems Estates 1?

data.answer:
Life in Gems Estates 1, DAMAC Hills promises an unparalleled blend of branded luxury, serene golf course views, and world-class amenities within a meticulously designed, nature-inspired community.

Transportation and Parking Spaces in Gems Estates 1

As Gems Estates 1 is still under development, public transport options within the community are yet to be introduced. Currently, there are no bus stops within the master DAMAC Hills community, the closest one is located in Mudon. It is just a five-minute drive away. Similarly, metro access is not directly available but residents will be able to reach Dubai Internet City Metro Station within 15 minutes by car, ensuring a convenient connection to key business and lifestyle hubs.

For private vehicle owners, the community is designed to accommodate effortless parking solutions. Each villa will include multiple covered parking spaces, catering to residents with multiple vehicles. With wide, well-planned roads and easy access to major highways like Emirates Road (E611) and Hessa Street (D61), commuting from Gems Estates 1 will be smooth and hassle-free.

Supermarkets Around Gems Estates 1

Once Gems Estates 1, DAMAC Hills is fully developed, residents will have convenient access to a range of supermarkets for daily essentials and gourmet selections. While the community itself is still taking shape, well-established grocery stores are just a short drive away. Carrefour, Spinneys, and VIVA Supermarket are among the closest options, offering everything from fresh produce to household necessities. 

Shopping Mall Near Gems Estates 1

A major retail destination within DAMAC Hills, DAMAC Mall opened its doors in September 2023, bringing a diverse shopping and lifestyle experience to the community. Just a short drive from Gems Estates 1, this contemporary mall features 40 retail stores, a variety of dining options, a Spinneys supermarket, a medical center, and a fully equipped gym.

As the area continues to develop, additional amenities and entertainment options are expected, ensuring that future residents will have a well-rounded shopping and leisure experience close to home.

Schools and Nurseries Near Gems Estates 1

Families in Gems Estates 1, DAMAC Hills will have access to quality education with a variety of schools and nurseries nearby. Jebel Ali School, located within DAMAC Hills, follows the British curriculum and currently caters to students up to Grade 13, making it a convenient option for residents seeking top-tier academic programs.

For early childhood education, Dibber Nurseries – DAMAC Hills Mudon Campus is a well-regarded choice, offering a Norwegian curriculum focused on high-quality early learning. Situated near Golf Horizon, it provides a nurturing environment for young children. Additionally, other nearby nurseries, including Blossoms Mudon Nursery and The Wonder Years Nursery, are within a 9 to 12-minute drive, ensuring multiple options for preschool education close to the community.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques Near Gems Estates 1

Residents of Gems Estates 1, DAMAC Hills will find several places of worship within a short drive from the community. For Muslim residents, Mudon Mosque, located in the neighboring Mudon community, offers a convenient prayer space. Additionally, Al Madinah Al Mustadama Masjid, situated just across from Mudon, is the closest mosque to DAMAC Hills, providing an accessible option for daily prayers.

For the Christian community, the United Christian Church of Dubai, located in Jebel Ali Village, is the nearest place of worship. Other churches, including Emirates Baptist Church and St. Francis of Assisi Catholic Church (Jebel Ali Church), are also within reach, approximately 20 minutes away, ensuring that residents have multiple options for religious gatherings and services.

Clinics and Hospitals Near Gems Estates 1

Future residents of Gems Estates 1, DAMAC Hills will have access to quality healthcare facilities within a short drive. The nearest full-service hospital, Mediclinic Parkview Hospital, is just 16 minutes away, offering a comprehensive range of medical services, including an outpatient department, emergency care, radiology, ICU, and pharmacy. Specialized treatments in obstetrics, gynecology, family medicine, and pediatrics ensure that residents will have access to top-tier medical care.

For routine check-ups and minor medical concerns, Aster Clinic and Core Care Polyclinic are nearby, providing essential healthcare services within the broader DAMAC Hills area. These facilities will cater to residents' medical needs, ensuring convenience and peace of mind in their day-to-day lives.

Location & Nearby Areas

Gems Estates 1, DAMAC Hills enjoys a prime location with seamless connectivity to some of Dubai’s most sought-after residential neighborhoods. The community is just 10 minutes away from Mudon and Arabian Ranches 2, while also being positioned adjacent to Remraam. Along Al Qudra Road (D63), residents will find The Sustainable City, Dubailand, and Town Square, offering a diverse mix of lifestyle and entertainment options. 

Additionally, Dubai Sports City, Dubai Motor City, and Arabian Ranches are within close proximity, providing easy access to vibrant hubs known for their leisure, sports, and retail attractions

more_info.question: Things to Do in DAMAC Hills Gems Estates 1

data.answer:
DAMAC Hills Gems Estates 1 is set to offer an unparalleled lifestyle where luxury meets tranquility, providing a refined living experience in one of Dubai’s most prestigious communities.

Beaches Near Gems Estates 1

Malibu Bay is a standout leisure attraction within the master-planned DAMAC Hills community, offering a unique beach-like experience in the heart of the city. This impressive man-made beach and wave pool spans an area one and a half times larger than a professional ice hockey rink, featuring a 24,700-square-foot pool with a giant wave ball imported from Belgium creating dynamic waves at its center. 

Beyond the wave pool, visitors can enjoy a variety of recreational activities, including food trucks, an ice rink, a splash park for children, and a skate park, making it a vibrant destination for families and thrill-seekers alike.

Outdoor Activities, Fitness and Beauty

Future residents of Gems Estates 1, DAMAC Hills will have access to an exceptional selection of outdoor, fitness, and wellness amenities designed to promote an active and luxurious lifestyle. The community will feature expansive green spaces, including beautifully designed public parks such as a skate park, central park, picnic park, and fruit park, offering serene escapes for relaxation and family outings.

For those seeking water-based recreation, Malibu Bay Wave Pool, scenic lakes, and the Wet Wadi Fountain will provide refreshing retreats, while children will have endless entertainment at the dedicated play areas, petting farm, Kids Crazy Golf, and an Ice Rink. Sports enthusiasts will benefit from a variety of world-class facilities, including basketball, football, tennis, volleyball, and padel courts, alongside a cricket field for competitive and leisure play.

Nature and wellness are seamlessly integrated into the community, with horse stables, fishing lakes, jogging tracks, and designated BBQ areas fostering a holistic lifestyle. Additionally, the community center and event spaces will serve as social hubs, while premium fitness and beauty amenities will cater to those looking to maintain their health and well-being in a truly luxurious setting.

Community Events

Future residents of Gems Estates 1 can expect a vibrant community atmosphere with exclusive events and social gatherings hosted within the DAMAC Hills master development. From seasonal celebrations and family-friendly festivals to wellness retreats and outdoor markets, the neighborhood will offer a dynamic calendar of activities designed to foster a strong sense of community. As the area develops, residents will have opportunities to engage with like-minded individuals, enjoy curated entertainment, and experience a lifestyle that blends luxury with a lively social scene.

Attractions and Landmarks

Residents of Gems Estates 1 will find a variety of entertainment and leisure destinations within easy reach. Cityland Mall, known for its unique botanical theme, is just 15 minutes away, offering a mix of retail, dining, and entertainment. 

For seamless connectivity, Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E311) can be accessed in 12 minutes, ensuring convenient travel across Dubai. Adventure seekers and nature enthusiasts will appreciate being 15 minutes from IMG Worlds of Adventure, one of the city’s largest indoor theme parks, and the enchanting Dubai Butterfly Garden, home to thousands of vibrant butterflies in a serene, nature-filled setting.
As Gems Estates 1 is an off-plan development, properties are currently under construction, and residents will need to wait for completion before moving in.

What is Gems Estates 1 in DAMAC Hills?

Gems Estates 1 is an upcoming ultra-luxury villa sub-community within DAMAC Hills, developed in collaboration with Roberto Cavalli and de GRISOGONO. It features opulent 5, 6, and 7-bedroom villas with branded interiors, exclusive amenities, and breathtaking golf course views.

Is Gems Estates 1 a completed development?

No, Gems Estates 1 is an off-plan project currently under development, with handovers expected upon completion.

What types of properties are available in Gems Estates 1?

The community offers 5, 6, and 7-bedroom villas, each designed with double-height ceilings, private pools, home theaters, and expansive living spaces to provide an unparalleled luxury lifestyle.

The developer offers a flexible 80/20 payment plan, requiring 20% at booking, 60% during construction, and the final 20% upon handover.

data.content:
Nestled within the prestigious DAMAC Hills community, Gems Estates 1 is an exclusive collection of ultra-luxurious villas that redefine sophisticated living. Developed by DAMAC Properties, this elite sub-community is the result of a remarkable collaboration between renowned Italian fashion house Roberto Cavalli and distinguished Swiss jeweler de GRISOGONO. The project embodies opulence, offering grand residences designed to exude elegance, artistry, and a distinctively lavish lifestyle.

The villas at DAMAC Hills Gems Estates 1 stand out with their striking exteriors crafted in deep black stone, a signature element inspired by de GRISOGONO’s timeless aesthetics. Inside, Cavalli’s iconic golden hues and bold animal prints infuse each residence with an extravagant yet refined ambiance. The artistic influence of Austrian master painter Gustav Klimt is subtly woven into the architecture, bringing a sense of drama and movement to every curve and detail.

Strategically positioned within DAMAC Hills, Gems Estates 1 enjoys excellent connectivity via major road networks such as Emirates Road (E611), Al Qudra Road (D63), Sheikh Zayed Bin Hamdan Al Nahyan Street (D54), and Hessa Street (D61). The community offers an array of five- to seven-bedroom mansions, making it an ideal address for those seeking a distinctive, freehold residence in one of Dubai’s most sought-after luxury neighborhoods.
